+/*
+ * @test
+ * @bug 8393882
+ * @summary Tests the validation of the BreakIterator data
+ * @modules java.base/sun.text
+ * @run junit BreakIteratorDataValidation
+ */
+
+import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
+import java.util.MissingResourceException;
+
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
+import sun.text.RuleBasedBreakIterator;
+
+import static org.junit.Assert.assertThrows;
+
+public class BreakIteratorDataValidation {
+    private static final int DATASIZE =
+            48 // size including checksum
+            + 1 // one endState, avoiding zero division with endStates.length
+            + 1_024; // BMPindices
+    @ParameterizedTest
+    @ValueSource (ints = {12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36})
+    void hugeDataSizeTest(int index) {
+        byte[] data = ByteBuffer.allocate(DATASIZE)
+                .put(new byte[]{'B', 'I', 'd', 'a', 't', 'a', 0, 1})
+                .putInt(DATASIZE - 12) // totalDataSize
+                .putInt(20, 1) // endStates size
+                .putInt(index, Integer.MAX_VALUE) // huge table length
+                .array();
+
+        assertThrows("Malformed data was accepted",
+                MissingResourceException.class,
+                () -> new RuleBasedBreakIterator("test", data));
+    }
+
+    @ParameterizedTest
+    @ValueSource (ints = {12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36})
+    void negativeDataSizeTest(int index) {
+        byte[] data = ByteBuffer.allocate(DATASIZE)
+                .put(new byte[]{'B', 'I', 'd', 'a', 't', 'a', 0, 1})
+                .putInt(DATASIZE - 12) // totalDataSize
+                .putInt(20, 1) // endStates size
+                .putInt(index, -1) // negative data length
+                .array();
+
+        assertThrows("Malformed data was accepted",
+                MissingResourceException.class,
+                () -> new RuleBasedBreakIterator("test", data));
+    }
+}
